nodes.label: Study Session–Assignment Linking via assignment_id
nodes.rationale: Previously Study Session and Assignment were disconnected entities. Linking via nullable assignment_id FK lets LP Solver compute exact remaining required_hours per assignment instead of subject totals; SET NULL preserves sessions if assignment deleted.

nodes.label: W_max_effective Formula
nodes.rationale: W_max_effective = max(0.5, 6.0 × (1 - 0.5 × risk_score/100)). Higher risk lowers daily ceiling to prioritize sustainability over maximum throughput.

nodes.label: Diminishing Returns sqrt(x) Approximation
nodes.rationale: First 2 hours more effective than later hours; piecewise-linear sqrt on [0,4] with decreasing slopes (1.414→0.293) spreads hours across assignments instead of linear 10×=10× crowding.

nodes.label: Soft Constraints Avoid Dead-End
nodes.rationale: Deadline and daily cap as soft constraints via slack s[i]/u[d] penalized in objective guarantees solver always returns best-effort schedule with shortfall/overload warnings instead of infeasible dead-end.

nodes.label: Tier 1 Quick Interactions Mobile-First UX
nodes.rationale: Students log immediately after studying on mobile; Quick widgets cut taps 4→2, 4→1, 6→2 etc (total 5 taps for all three log types) to reduce friction without losing data quality.

nodes.label: Rule-Based No-ML Transparency Principle
nodes.rationale: Rule-based instead of ML ensures transparency and auditability by reading source; avoids black-box AI for sensitive stress topic and keeps unit testing of pure functions trivial.

nodes.label: Objective Maximize Effective Learning
nodes.rationale: Maximize Σ E[i]·f(X_eff) − penalties balances urgency×difficulty×priority against shortfall/overload; result is risk-aware and time-of-day aware without hard-coding deadlines.

nodes.label: Sleep Wake-Next-Day Logic
nodes.rationale: User enters 23:00 sleep and 07:00 wake; without auto +1 day frontend would violate backend wake_time>sleep_time check. Frontend corrects before send so users never see 422.

nodes.label: Ethics: No Burnout Diagnosis with Mandatory Disclaimer
nodes.norm_label: ethics: no burnout diagnosis with mandatory disclaimer
nodes.rationale: Burnout is a clinical concept needing standardized scales and professionals; self-reported sleep/study data cannot diagnose it. System therefore provides only workload stress indicator with mandatory medical disclaimer and transparent formula.

nodes.label: required_hours=0 Domain Semantics Fix (ge=0)
nodes.rationale: required_hours=0 is a valid business state (user has no assignments) but Field(gt=0) rejected it with 422→502. Changing to ge=0 validates by domain semantics while keeping available_hours gt=0 to avoid division by zero.

nodes.label: Graceful Degradation via 502 on Tier 2 Down
nodes.norm_label: graceful degradation via 502 on tier 2 down
nodes.rationale: Microservice calls must handle failures at the caller; wrapping httpx errors into 502 Gateway prevents leaking internal Tier 2 errors and avoids cascade failure when Risk Indicator is down.

nodes.label: W_max_effective Risk-Adjusted Daily Cap
nodes.rationale: Risk-adjusted cap formula W_max_effective = 6.0 × (1 - 0.5 × risk_score / 100) from thesis. Higher risk lowers permitted daily hours to protect sustainability; verified on UI (36.6 risk → 4.9h). Two-step fallback retries with original 6.0h plus risk_override warning if solver infeasible.

nodes.label: Quick Interactions V2 (5-Tap Friction Reduction)
nodes.rationale: Students log on mobile right after studying; long forms and page switches are friction. Quick widgets on Dashboard reduce logging all three types to 5 taps, turning Dashboard into an input hub/command center.

nodes.label: DEFAULT_LAMBDA_DAILY single source of truth
nodes.rationale: Bug in solver.py hardcoded 5.0 causing HTTP vs direct-call inconsistency; importing DEFAULT_LAMBDA constants guarantees one source of truth and consistent behaviour across HTTP and direct paths.

nodes.label: 2-step Fallback on Infeasible
nodes.rationale: Step 1 solves with W_max_effective, Step 2 retries with original W_max plus user warning to preserve usability under high risk and heavy workloads.

nodes.label: Soft Constraints deadline and daily cap
nodes.norm_label: soft constraints deadline and daily cap
nodes.rationale: Soft constraints with penalty lambda_daily=100 (lambda_deadline=20) ensure the solver always returns a feasible schedule with warnings rather than Infeasible; penalty must dominate max marginal gain E_max*slope_max ~35 so overflow is never abused and deadlines are preferred over daily overload.

nodes.label: W_max_effective risk integration
nodes.rationale: Risk score from Tier 2 scales the daily cap to avoid the positive feedback loop where high risk lowers W_max_effective making deadlines infeasible; combined with soft constraints and fallback retry it mitigates infeasibility.

nodes.label: Feedback FR 13 1-5 star rating
nodes.rationale: User feedback on generated schedules provides data to tune Risk Indicator weights in future versions.

nodes.label: Diminishing Returns piecewise-linear sqrt(x) approximation
nodes.rationale: 4-segment piecewise linear approximation with decreasing slopes (1.414, 0.586, 0.414, 0.293) lets the maximisation LP fill the highest-slope segment first with no binary variables for segment ordering, reducing MILP complexity and solving faster.

nodes.label: W_max_effective formula W_max*(1-alpha*Risk/100)
nodes.rationale: Thesis formula with alpha=0.5 verified on UI: risk 36.6 yields W_max_eff 4.9h from 6.0h, matching theory 100%.

nodes.label: Alembic Autogenerate Missing Indexes
nodes.rationale: Autogenerate omits indexes unless Index() declared; must manually add 11 op.create_index plus downgrade and declare __table_args__ to guarantee query performance and correct rollback.

nodes.label: Race Condition tokenOverride Fix
nodes.rationale: Login treated token as stored before calling /me, causing interceptor to miss Authorization header and return Not authenticated. Fix sets token state early and passes tokenOverride directly instead of relying on async store update.

nodes.label: Transactional Rollback and Cross-User Isolation
nodes.rationale: Each test runs in its own transaction rolled back afterward for independence without recreating DB; cross-user tests prove ownership filtering and prevent one user reading/deleting another's data.

nodes.label: str.replace URL Bug via rsplit Fix
nodes.norm_label: str.replace url bug via rsplit fix
nodes.rationale: str.replace replaces ALL occurrences, so DB URL replacement corrupted username study_planner→study_planner_test causing 93 ERRORs at 61% coverage. Using rsplit('/',1) replaces only the final DB-name segment, restoring 93.89% coverage.

nodes.label: W_max Effective = 6.0 x (1-0.5xRisk/100)
nodes.rationale: Reduce daily study cap as risk rises: W_max_effective = 6.0 x (1-0.5 x risk/100), min 0.5; risk 40 gives 4.8h, 100 gives 3.0h.

nodes.label: Heuristic Weights Limitation
nodes.rationale: Weights 0.35/0.30/0.20/0.15, ALPHA 0.5, lambda 20/100, buffer 25%, tod 1.2/1.0/0.8 are hand-chosen, not calibrated on real user data.

nodes.label: Rule-Based Workload Stress Indicator
nodes.rationale: Rule-based not ML for transparency/auditability; no clinical Burnout Detection, only behavioral workload stress with mandatory disclaimer; stateless, no PII.

nodes.label: Ethics No Burnout Detection Disclaimer
nodes.rationale: Burnout is clinical and needs Maslach inventory plus expert; self-reported sleep/study cannot diagnose, so only behavioral workload stress indicator with transparent formula and mandatory disclaimer.

nodes.label: Graceful Degradation 502 Tier2 Down
nodes.rationale: Tier1 wraps Tier2 httpx call in try/except returning 502 Risk service unavailable so one microservice down does not cascade-fail the whole system.

nodes.label: MILP Diminishing Returns Soft Constraints
nodes.rationale: Soft constraints avoid infeasible dead-ends: penalize deadline shortfall and daily overload via slack s[i]/u[d] and warnings instead of hard failure, enabling safer UX.

nodes.label: Penalty Tuning lambda_daily 100 lambda_deadline 20
nodes.rationale: lambda_daily=100 must dominate max marginal gain E_max*slope_max about 35 so solver never abuses daily cap; lambda_deadline=20 lower to prefer shortfall warning over overload.

nodes.label: Explainability with Explanation and Warnings
nodes.rationale: Returning per_subject/per_day explanation, objective_value and warnings avoids black-box; users see why schedule looks that way and trust/adjust it, unlike ML models that hide reasoning.

nodes.label: Partial Update exclude_unset Pattern
nodes.rationale: model_dump(exclude_unset=True) updates only fields client actually sent, distinguishing omitted vs explicit null; avoids overwriting untouched fields and enables PATCH-like semantics via PUT.

nodes.label: Two-Layer Delete Confirmation
nodes.rationale: Destructive account wipe requires both checkbox and typing exact username (plus backend confirm flag), preventing accidental misclicks; mimics GitHub/Shopify best practice for irreversible actions.

nodes.label: Graphify Query Rules
nodes.rationale: Query graph before grep for codebase questions; use path/explain for scoped subgraphs; rebuild via graphify update after code changes.

nodes.label: JWT Authentication Bcrypt Cost 12
nodes.rationale: Access token in memory (not localStorage) to reduce XSS, refresh in HTTP-only cookie, 30min/7day expiry, ownership checks per user_id.
